title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: Version 1.2.0 of FlowMLLab, an installable and validation-oriented framework connecting continuum CFD, a D2Q9 cylinder-wake lattice-Boltzmann module, centered POD and neural field surrogates, cavity POD-Galerkin and POD-DEIM models, DSMC, physical diagnostics, tutorial notebooks, and reproducible evidence.
